FULLMOONKNIGHT-EQUIP.title: Equipment
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EQUIP.description: Lasts for the rest of combat once played. Copies of the same Equipment stack.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COUNTER.title: Counter
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COUNTER.description: Sets a Counter. When an enemy takes a matching action, the action is negated for you (teammates are still affected), the Counter resolves and is removed. An enemy's [gold]Artifact[/gold] blocks the Counter and loses 1 stack. Untriggered Counters last until the end of combat and trigger in the order they were set.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PIERCE.title: Piercing
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FIRE.title: Fire
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FIRE.description: Fire-element damage. Deals the same amount as normal damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-THUNDER.title: Thunder
FULLMOONKNIGHT-THUNDER.description: Thunder-element damage. Deals the same amount as normal damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STEAL.title: Steal
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STEAL.description: The [gold]Block[/gold], healing and buffs the enemy would give itself go to you instead; debuffs, status cards and damage aimed at you are cancelled. Summoning and escaping cannot be stolen.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMPORARY.description: A card created during this combat. [gold]Exhausts[/gold] when played and disappears at the end of combat.
